high_voltage_refused.title: Connected (DEMO)

high_voltage_refused.caution: The program restores the 34410A factory defaults (*RST) before the first point, then sets function, range, 100 NPLC or the 3 Hz AC filter for every point.
steps: Warm-up
The 34410A must have warmed up for 90 minutes with a copper short connected (Service Guide p. 67). Allow the calibrator its own warm-up time as well.
Environment
Ambient 18 to 28 C (ideally 23 C +/- 2 C) and relative humidity below 80 % (p. 67).
Cables
Shielded twisted-pair PTFE cables, as short as possible, shields to earth ground at ONE place (p. 67).
Front / Rear
The program reads the Front/Rear switch (ROUT:TERM?) before every point and stops if it is wrong; it cannot move the switch. Never move it with signals present.
high_voltage_refused.title: Before the verification

high_voltage_refused.text:
Before the first test point every instrument is reset to its default settings.

Unit under test that will be reset: 34410A.

Resetting a unit under test can ERASE settings stored on it (set-ups, configuration, preferences). Save anything you need from it first.

Reset the instruments and start?

high_voltage_refused.caution: The calibrator stays in STANDBY. Never use it as a zero source.
facts: Front DC current, 100.0 µA range (input open)
steps: Front/Rear switch
Set the Front/Rear switch to FRONT (with nothing connected to the terminals). The program checks the switch position before measuring.
Set up the input
Select the FRONT terminals; leave the current (I) input OPEN, nothing connected. The calibrator stays in STANDBY.

Stabilise

warmup_cancelled.caution: The program restores the 34410A factory defaults (*RST) before the first point, then sets function, range, 100 NPLC or the 3 Hz AC filter for every point.
steps: Warm-up
The 34410A must have warmed up for 90 minutes with a copper short connected (Service Guide p. 67). Allow the calibrator its own warm-up time as well.
Environment
Ambient 18 to 28 C (ideally 23 C +/- 2 C) and relative humidity below 80 % (p. 67).
Cables
Shielded twisted-pair PTFE cables, as short as possible, shields to earth ground at ONE place (p. 67).
Front / Rear
The program reads the Front/Rear switch (ROUT:TERM?) before every point and stops if it is wrong; it cannot move the switch. Never move it with signals present.
